meta.title: Community — Redact Secret
meta.description: Report a bug, a false positive or a missed detection, request a detector, or ask a question. This page checks your report for secrets in your browser, then opens the matching GitHub form already filled in.

title: Tell us what broke
or what's missing
hero.lede: Pick what you want to tell us. You fill a short form here, this page checks it for secrets in your browser, and GitHub opens with the form already filled in. You review it and press Submit there.

facts.lead: Nothing is sent from this page.
facts.body: The check runs in your browser.

bug.name: Bug report
bug.where: A crash, an error, or JS/Python/Rust/CLI disagreeing
bug.intro: For code defects. If a value was flagged when it shouldn't be, or missed when it should be caught, use False positive or Missed detection instead.

what-happened.label: What happened, and what did you expect instead?

repro.label: Minimal synthetic reproduction
repro.help: Only independently authored synthetic values. Never a real credential, even truncated or masked.

bug.ack: I have not included any live, revoked-but-real, or real-derived credential, or any real personal data, anywhere in this report.

false-positive.name: False positive
false-positive.where: Flagged or redacted, but it isn't a secret
intro: Filing does not change a fixture by itself. Accepted reports go through the known-gap lifecycle in

repro-shape.label: Safe reproduction shape
repro-shape.help: A synthetic value with the same grammar, prefix, and length as the real one. Never the real value.

false-positive.ack: I have not included any live, revoked-but-real, or real-derived credential, or any real personal data, anywhere in this report.

missed-detection.name: Missed detection
missed-detection.where: A secret got through, or got the wrong action
missed-detection.intro: Describe the shape of the value, never the value. If this is an exploitable bypass, report it privately under Security instead.

repro-shape.label: Safe reproduction shape
repro-shape.help: A synthetic value with the same grammar, prefix, and length as the real one. Never the real value.

missed-detection.ack: I have not included any live, revoked-but-real, or real-derived credential, or any real personal data, anywhere in this report.

website.name: Website problem
website.where: A broken link, wrong copy, a translation, the playground
website.intro: The site's own repository is private, so website reports are filed in the product repository and stay there.

kind.label: What kind of problem is this?

website.ack: I have not included any real credential or real personal data, including anything I typed into the playground.

detector.name: Request a detector
detector.where: A provider, credential family, or PII entity we don't cover
detector.intro: A public format description is enough to start. A request is not a commitment or a stable classification.

use-case.label: Where does it appear?
use-case.help: A prompt, tool result, log, trace, or user input. No production data.

relevant-details.label: Relevant format or context
relevant-details.help: Only publicly documented structure and benign lookalikes. No values, no bypass recipe.

detector.ack: I have not included real credentials, real-derived credentials, personal data, or unsanitized customer material.

integration.name: Integration or docs
integration.where: Stuck installing, an adapter, or a guide that doesn't help
integration.intro: Tell us where you got stuck. A short description is welcome; the maintainer can ask for details later.

topic.label: What kind of feedback is this?

problem.label: What happened, and what were you trying to do?
problem.placeholder: I followed the Pino guide and got stuck at …

integration.ack: I have not included real credentials, personal data, or unsanitized customer material.

question.name: Ask a question
question.where: How do I…? Answers stay findable for the next person
question.intro: For usage and integration questions. For a reproducible bug or a concrete request, use an issue form instead.
question.ack: I have not included any real, revoked-but-real, or real-derived credential, or any real personal data, in this post.

idea.name: Share an idea
idea.where: Early, not yet concrete. Becomes a request once it is
idea.intro: When an idea has a public format link and a use case, it moves to a detector request.
idea.ack: I have not included any real, revoked-but-real, or real-derived credential, or any real personal data, in this post.

security.name: Security vulnerability
security.where: Private advisory. Never a public form
security.title: Report a vulnerability privately
security.body: A bypass, a leak of matched plaintext, or anything else an attacker could use goes to a private security advisory, not a public form. Only the maintainers see it until a fix is ready.
rules: Use unmistakably synthetic or revoked examples.
Name the affected API or detector, the expected and observed result, and a minimal reproduction.
Do not disclose publicly until a fix and timeline are agreed.

form.titleHelp: One line. GitHub adds the prefix.

handoff.title: Check and continue

idle.body: The check runs as you type once a field has text.

loading.body: The detection engine loads in your browser. Nothing is sent.

clean.body: Checked every field in your browser. Review the text again on GitHub before you submit.

handoff.foundOne: 1 possible secret found. Remove it to continue
foundMany: possible secrets found. Remove them to continue
handoff.foundBody: Replace the value with a synthetic one of the same shape. The value is never shown here.

failed.body: Your browser could not run the detection engine, so this page cannot check your text.

stale.verdict: This page is out of date
stale.body: The site was updated while this tab was open. Reload to run the check.

handoff.urlHidden: Hidden until the possible secrets are removed.
handoff.tooLong: the address is short enough for GitHub (shorten the longest field and paste the rest on GitHub)
handoff.privacy: What you typed goes into the GitHub address, so it also stays in your browser history. GitHub asks you to confirm the safety checkbox again before you submit.
handoff.fallback: Open the blank form on GitHub instead

noscript: This page needs JavaScript to check your report. Without it,

noscript.a: choose a blank form on GitHub

noscript: and never paste a real credential.
boundary: The check on this page is preventive. It cannot see what you type on GitHub, and it is not the product's enforcement boundary.
